<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1800" height="1200" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1800px) 100vw, 1800px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7320" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends.jpeg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends.jpeg 1800w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1024x683.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1536x1024.jpeg 1536w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1200x800.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-24x16.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-36x24.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-48x32.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim" style="background-color:#909ea7"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Kite Camp in Punta Trettu, Sardinia<br>— 5 Days That Will Change How You See the Wind</h2>
<p class="has-text-align-center"></p>
</div></div>
<p>&#8220;This isn&#8217;t a trip. It&#8217;s an experience — where kitesurfing meets adventure, the sea meets the sun, and you meet people who love life as much as you do.&#8221;</p>
<p>Welcome to the&nbsp;<strong>Kite Camp in Punta Trettu</strong>&nbsp;— the most immersive kitesurfing experience in Sardinia. Five days, five nights, all-inclusive: your kite course, your gear, your room, and a crew of like-minded people who came here for the same reason you did. The wind.</p>
<p>Punta Trettu is not just a kite spot. It&#8217;s one of the best flat-water lagoons in Europe — shallow, safe, consistently windy, and breathtakingly beautiful. This is where you come to learn fast, progress hard, and live fully.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img decoding="async" width="1440" height="998" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1440px) 100vw, 1440px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7317" alt="Kitesurf Camp in Punta Trettu" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water.jpeg" style="object-position:61% 79%" data-object-fit="cover" data-object-position="61% 79%" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water.jpeg 1440w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-300x208.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-1024x710.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-768x532.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-1200x832.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-24x17.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-36x25.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-ounta-Trettu-with-flat-and-shallow-water-48x33.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-and-sleep">#1. Everything You Need. Nothing You Don&#8217;t.</h2>
</div></div>
<p>Your Kite Camp package is&nbsp;<strong>fully all-inclusive</strong>. From the moment you arrive, everything is taken care of. You just need to show up ready to fly.</p>
<p>🪁</p>
<p>Kite Course</p>
<p>Full beginner to riding progression over 5 days</p>
<p>🏠</p>
<p>Accommodation</p>
<p>5 nights in Villa Punta Trettu, en-suite room</p>
<p>🦺</p>
<p>Wetsuit</p>
<p>Personal wetsuit delivered on Day 1</p>
<p>⚙️</p>
<p>Harness &amp; Helmet</p>
<p>Personal harness and helmet, yours for the week</p>
<p>🏄</p>
<p>All Kite Equipment</p>
<p>Kites, bars, boards — professional gear included</p>
<p>👥</p>
<p>The Community</p>
<p>A group of passionate, like-minded kite addicts</p>
<p>On the first day of the camp, you&#8217;ll receive your&nbsp;<strong>personal wetsuit, harness (trapeze) and helmet</strong>. These are yours to use throughout the entire camp and returned at the end. No rental queues. No shared gear. Your kit, your setup.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="1800" height="1200" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1800px) 100vw, 1800px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7320" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends.jpeg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends.jpeg 1800w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1024x683.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1536x1024.jpeg 1536w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-1200x800.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-24x16.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-36x24.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-Sardinia-with-new-friends-48x32.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-camp">#2. This Is Not a Holiday Package. It&#8217;s a Life Experience.</h2>
</div></div>
<p>Forget the standard surf trips where you&#8217;re just another booking. Our Kite Camp is built around&nbsp;<strong>real connection, real progression, and real adventure</strong>. You&#8217;ll share this experience with people who love sport, the ocean, nature, and the kind of freedom that only wind and water can give.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">What Makes the Kite Camp Unique</h3>
<p>✦ You stay&nbsp;<strong>directly on the kite spot</strong>&nbsp;— walk out of your room, step onto the beach</p>
<p>✦ Small groups for&nbsp;<strong>maximum instructor attention and faster progression</strong></p>
<p>✦ Evenings built for&nbsp;<strong>socializing, Sardinian food, and unforgettable shared moments</strong></p>
<p>✦ A community that will last well beyond the 5 days</p>
<p>Every morning you wake up to the sound of the wind already building over the lagoon. By afternoon you&#8217;re on the water. By evening you&#8217;re sharing stories around the table with people who just became your friends. That&#8217;s the camp.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img decoding="async" width="1420" height="1064" sizes="(max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1420px) 100vw, 1420px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-6868" alt="Kite Spot of Punta Trettu" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot.jpg" data-object-fit="cover" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot.jpg 1420w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-300x225.jpg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-1024x767.jpg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-768x575.jpg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-1200x899.jpg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-24x18.jpg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-36x27.jpg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/punta-trettu-kite-spot-48x36.jpg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="availability">#3. <strong>Punta Trettu: The Best Kite Spot in Sardinia</strong></h2>
</div></div>
<p>Punta Trettu is widely recognized as&nbsp;<strong>one of the finest kitesurfing locations in Europe</strong>. A vast tidal lagoon with shallow, flat water — often knee-deep across much of the launch zone — makes it uniquely safe and effective for learning, while the consistent thermal and mistral winds keep experienced riders coming back year after year.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Why Punta Trettu is Perfect for a Kite Camp</h3>
<p><strong>Flat water. Consistent wind. No waves. No crowds.</strong>&nbsp;The lagoon&#8217;s natural shape creates an ideal learning environment: shallow enough to stand up at any point, wide enough to give you space, and deep enough in the channels to practice waterstarting and riding. It&#8217;s arguably the best place in the Mediterranean to learn kitesurfing.</p>
<p>The surrounding landscape — wild Sardinian scrubland, crystalline waters, and empty beaches — makes every session feel like a scene from a dream.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1440" height="998" sizes="auto, (max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1440px) 100vw, 1440px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7319" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg" style="object-position:41% 100%" data-object-fit="cover" data-object-position="41% 100%" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg 1440w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-300x208.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1024x710.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-768x532.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1200x832.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-24x17.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-36x25.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-48x33.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-spots">#4. <strong>Your Home on the Spot: Villa Punta Trettu</strong></h2>
</div></div>
<p>Sleep, eat, and live kitesurfing. Your camp accommodation is at&nbsp;<strong>Villa Punta Trettu</strong>&nbsp;— an exclusive kitesurf house located&nbsp;<em>directly at the spot</em>. No transfers. No driving. Just walk out and go.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Private En-Suite Rooms</h3>
<p>Each room features its own&nbsp;<strong>private bathroom</strong>, independent entrance, and smart air conditioning. Comfortable, clean, and perfectly equipped for a sports holiday — with high-speed Wi-Fi for when you eventually stop thinking about kites.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Designed for Kitesurfers</h3>
<p>The villa is built with riders in mind: outdoor showers to rinse your gear, a dedicated equipment storage area, a professional kitchen, a lush private garden, and a swimming pool to recover between sessions. After a massive day on the water, this is exactly where you want to be.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">A Basecamp, Not Just a Hotel</h3>
<p>The villa becomes your camp headquarters — a place to debrief the day&#8217;s sessions, plan tomorrow&#8217;s kiting, share meals, and build the kind of friendships that happen when you put passionate people in the same place with the same wind.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1440" height="998" sizes="auto, (max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1440px) 100vw, 1440px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7319" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg" style="object-position:41% 100%" data-object-fit="cover" data-object-position="41% 100%" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg 1440w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-300x208.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1024x710.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-768x532.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1200x832.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-24x17.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-36x25.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-48x33.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-spots">#5. <strong>5 Days at the Cam</strong></h2>
</div></div>
<p>Each Kite Camp runs on&nbsp;<strong>fixed dates — 5 days, 5 nights</strong>. Here&#8217;s how the progression is designed:</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Day 1 &#8211; Arrival &amp; Equipment Day</h4>
<p>Check in to Villa Punta Trettu. Receive your personal wetsuit, harness, and helmet. First briefing: theory, wind mechanics, and kite safety. First hands-on session with the trainer kite on the beach.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Day 2 &#8211; Kite Control &amp; Body Drag</h4>
<p>Master the power zone, edge control, and body dragging in the water. You&#8217;ll feel the power of the kite for the first time — and it will be addictive.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Day 3 &#8211; Waterstart</h4>
<p>The moment you&#8217;ve been waiting for. Instructor-assisted waterstart practice: board on feet, kite in the sky, and the goal of standing up for the first time.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Day 4 &#8211; First Rides &amp; Upwind Progress</h4>
<p>First independent rides across the lagoon. Start working on upwind technique. Your confidence is building fast — the flat water of Punta Trettu makes all the difference.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Day 5 &#8211; Full Sessions &amp; Level Assessment</h4>
<p>Full supervised sessions on the water. Level assessment and personalized next steps. Return of personal equipment. Last dinner together — and the moment you realize you&#8217;re now a kitesurfer.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1440" height="998" sizes="auto, (max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1440px) 100vw, 1440px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7319" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg" style="object-position:41% 100%" data-object-fit="cover" data-object-position="41% 100%" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg 1440w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-300x208.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1024x710.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-768x532.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1200x832.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-24x17.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-36x25.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-48x33.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-spots">#6. <strong>Made for People Who Want More Than a Vacation</strong></h2>
</div></div>
<p>Our Kite Camp is for&nbsp;<strong>anyone who wants to learn kitesurfing from zero</strong>, and do it surrounded by the right people, in the right place, at the right pace. No prior experience required — our certified instructors start from the absolute beginning and guide you through every stage of the learning curve.</p>
<p>It&#8217;s also for people who are done with passive holidays. You want to&nbsp;<strong>challenge yourself, learn something real, connect with the ocean</strong>, and return home with a skill, a community, and a set of memories that a beach resort simply cannot give you.</p>
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">The Camp Is Right for You If:</h3>
<p>You love sport, adventure, the sea, and nature. You want to try kitesurfing in the safest and most beautiful conditions in Sardinia. You want to share the experience with other passionate, like-minded people. And you want all of it handled — gear, instruction, accommodation — so all you have to do is show up and learn.</p>
<div class="wp-block-cover alignwide is-light is-position-center-center" style="min-height:375px;aspect-ratio:unset;"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1440" height="998" sizes="auto, (max-width: 799px) 200vw, (max-width: 1440px) 100vw, 1440px" class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7319" alt="" src="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg" style="object-position:41% 100%" data-object-fit="cover" data-object-position="41% 100%" srcset="https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu.jpeg 1440w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-300x208.jpeg 300w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1024x710.jpeg 1024w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-768x532.jpeg 768w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-1200x832.jpeg 1200w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-24x17.jpeg 24w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-36x25.jpeg 36w, https://kitegeneration.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/Kite-Camp-in-Punta-Trettu-48x33.jpeg 48w" /><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="kite-spots">#7. <strong>Frequently Asked Questions</strong></h2>
</div></div>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">What is included in the Kite Camp at Punta Trettu?</h4>
<p>The Kite Camp includes 5 days and 5 nights of accommodation at Villa Punta Trettu with private en-suite rooms, a full kitesurfing course from beginner to first independent rides, and all necessary equipment: kites, board, wetsuit, harness (trapeze), and helmet. The wetsuit, harness, and helmet are provided personally to each participant on Day 1 and collected at the end of the camp.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Do I need prior kitesurfing experience to join the camp?</h4>
<p>No experience is needed. The Kite Camp at Punta Trettu is designed for complete beginners. Our certified instructors build your skills progressively over 5 days, from theory and kite control on the beach to body dragging, waterstarting, and first independent rides on the lagoon.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Where is the accommodation during the Kite Camp?</h4>
<p>Camp participants stay at Villa Punta Trettu, a dedicated kitesurf villa located directly at the kite spot. Rooms are private with en-suite bathrooms. The villa features a swimming pool, private garden, professional kitchen, and kite-friendly facilities including outdoor showers and equipment storage.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Why is Punta Trettu the best place to learn kitesurfing in Sardinia?</h4>
<p>Punta Trettu is a wide, shallow tidal lagoon with flat water and consistent thermal and mistral winds. The shallow depth means you can stand up at almost any point in the learning area, making it uniquely safe for beginners. It is widely considered one of the best kitesurfing spots in Europe, especially for learning and progression.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">When do the Kite Camps take place?</h4>
<p>Kite Camps in Punta Trettu run on specific fixed dates throughout the kitesurfing season. Each camp lasts exactly 5 days and 5 nights. Availability is limited — check the current schedule and book your dates early as spots fill up quickly.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Is the Kite Camp social? Will I meet other people?</h4>
<p>Yes — community is at the heart of the Kite Camp experience. You&#8217;ll join a small group of participants who share a passion for sport, adventure, and the sea. Evenings include shared dinners and social moments. Many camp participants leave with lasting friendships formed over five days of kiting together.</p>
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">What is the difference between the Kite Camp and the Kite &amp; Sleep package?</h4>
<p>The Kite Camp is a fixed-date, fully immersive group experience that includes accommodation, course, equipment, and social activities — available only on select dates. The Kite &amp; Sleep package is a more flexible option available year-round that combines kite lessons with accommodation, but is not tied to a specific group camp format.</p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">SPOTS ARE LIMITED. WIND IS NOT.</h2>
